result.instructions: Tools for Rivo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers have the most points, and what VIP tier are they in?"; "Show me the rewards that were redeemed the most this month."; "List the referrals still pending and the customers who made them.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rivo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rivo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rivo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rivo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rivo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rivo_get_shop
tools.title: Get shop details
tools.description: Return the store's details (name, domain, currency and loyalty settings). Merchant API: GET /v1/shop.

tools.name: rivo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the store's customers with their loyalty status, VIP tier and points balance. Filter by status or points range. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/customers.

vip_tier.description: Only customers in this VIP tier (name).

points_min.description: Only customers with at least this many points (inclusive).

points_max.description: Only customers with at most this many points (inclusive).

since_id.description: Only records with an id greater than this. Start with 0; then pass links.next_since_id from the last reply.

tools.name: rivo_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Return one customer by Shopify customer ID or e-mail: loyalty status, VIP tier and points. Optional extra fields: next_vip_tier, lifetime_earnings_tally, completed_earning_rule_ids, points_breakdown. Merchant API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_identifier}.

customer.description: Shopify customer ID or e-mail address of the customer.

fields.description: Extra fields to include in the reply.

tools.name: rivo_list_points_events
tools.title: List points events
tools.description: List points events (points earned or spent, adjustments, expiries). Filter by customer and applied date. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/points_events.

customer.description: Only events for this customer (Shopify ID or e-mail).

applied_from.description: Only events applied on or after this date-time.

applied_before.description: Only events applied before this date-time.

since_id.description: Only records with an id greater than this. Start with 0; then pass links.next_since_id from the last reply.

tools.name: rivo_list_points_redemptions
tools.title: List points redemptions
tools.description: List points redemptions (a customer spends points on a reward and gets a discount code). Filter by customer, reward or discount code. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/points_redemptions.

customer.description: Only redemptions by this customer (Shopify ID or e-mail).

code.description: Only the redemption with this discount code.

used.description: true = discount code used, false = not used yet.

applied_from.description: Only redemptions applied on or after this date-time.

applied_before.description: Only redemptions applied before this date-time.

since_id.description: Only records with an id greater than this. Start with 0; then pass links.next_since_id from the last reply.

tools.name: rivo_get_points_redemption
tools.title: Get a points redemption
tools.description: Return one points redemption by id: customer, reward, points spent and discount code. Merchant API: GET /v1/points_redemptions/{id}.

tools.name: rivo_list_rewards
tools.title: List rewards
tools.description: List the store's loyalty rewards (points cost, value, enabled state, redemption count). Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/rewards.

purchase_type.description: Only rewards for this purchase type.

since_id.description: Only records with an id greater than this. Start with 0; then pass links.next_since_id from the last reply.

tools.name: rivo_get_reward
tools.title: Get a reward
tools.description: Return one loyalty reward by id. Merchant API: GET /v1/rewards/{id}.

tools.name: rivo_list_vip_tiers
tools.title: List VIP tiers
tools.description: List the store's VIP tiers (name, threshold and perks). Merchant API: GET /v1/vip_tiers.

since_id.description: Only records with an id greater than this. Start with 0; then pass links.next_since_id from the last reply.

tools.name: rivo_list_referrals
tools.title: List referrals
tools.description: List referrals (a referrer invites a friend; the referral completes or is blocked). Filter by status, customers or date. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/referrals.

referrer_customer_id.description: Only referrals by this referrer (customer ID).

referred_customer_id.description: Only referrals of this referred customer (customer ID).

updated_from.description: Only referrals updated on or after this date-time.

updated_before.description: Only referrals updated before this date-time.

since_id.description: Only records with an id greater than this. Start with 0; then pass links.next_since_id from the last reply.

tools.name: rivo_list_favorite_products
tools.title: List a customer's favourite products
tools.description: List the products one customer saved as favourites. Merchant API: GET /v1/favorite_products (customer_id is a required query parameter).

data_source.description: Where the product data comes from (default db).

since_id.description: Only records with an id greater than this. Start with 0; then pass links.next_since_id from the last reply.

tools.name: rivo_adjust_customer_points
tools.title: Add or remove customer points
tools.description: WRITE: add or subtract points (and store credits) for one customer, as a manual points event. Positive numbers add, negative numbers subtract. The internal note is for the merchant; the external note is shown to the customer. Merchant API: POST /v1/points_events.

customer.description: Shopify customer ID or e-mail address of the customer.

points.description: Points to add (positive) or remove (negative). Required for a manual event.

credits.description: Store credits to add (positive) or remove (negative).

internal_note.description: Note for the merchant only (not shown to the customer).

skip_email.description: true = do not send the points e-mail to the customer.

tools.name: rivo_set_reward_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable a reward
tools.description: WRITE: turn one loyalty reward on or off for customers. Other reward settings stay as they are. Merchant API: PUT /v1/rewards/{id}.

enabled.description: true = customers can redeem it; false = hidden and not redeemable.

tools.name: rivo_add_favorite_product
tools.title: Add a favourite product
tools.description: WRITE: save a product (optionally a variant) to one customer's favourites. Merchant API: POST /v1/favorite_products.

data_source.description: Where the product data comes from.

tools.name: rivo_remove_favorite_product
tools.title: Remove a favourite product
tools.description: WRITE: remove a product from one customer's favourites. Merchant API: DELETE /v1/favorite_products/{product_id}.

data_source.description: Where the product data comes from.

prompts.title: Get started with Rivo
